name: Head Over Heels
description: A teenage shaman determined to change fate sets out to save a mysterious boy destined to die. As danger looms, their fated encounter sparks a powerful first love that defies darkness and reclaims hope.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Just when the high-schooler shaman Seong-A is getting bored with life, handsome Gyeon-U walks into her shrine upside-down. But he's destined to die?

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Seong-A hangs around Gyeon-U even when he's suspected of arson. Another fire breaks out, and Seong-A jumps into the flames. All for one reason!

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Seong-A's the only one by Gyeon-U's side at the funeral. Her mission as a human amulet begins! Holding hands, linking arms - all to fend off the evil!

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: "Let's stay moist," Weird love confession, but the heart flutters! But what if Seong-A's biggest secret is tied with Gyeon-U's deepest wound?

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Gyeon-U loses trust in Seong-A when he realizes she's something he hates the most. Seong-A loses her human amulet power and wounds open up.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Seong-A finds out Yeomhwa relished Gyeon-U's suffering. Seong-A decides to take Yeomhwa head on to save Gyeon-U while he comes across her past online.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: When evil spirit Bong-su possesses Gyeon-woo's body and causes chaos, Gyeon-woo only emerges when his hand touches Seong-ah.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: At school, no one knows about Gyeon-woo and Seong-ah's relationship. While their relationship seems more like an exorcism than a romance, he finally declares his love at a critical point.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: Seong-ah cheers Gyeon-woo on, and he wins gold. Later, when Seong-ah falls ill, Gyeon-woo decides to care for her, but Bong-su gets in the way.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: People grow to like the new Gyeon-woo, who is actually Bong-su. Bong-su realises he wants to become human, and Seong-ah decides to protect him.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: When Seong-ah leaves everyone in order to protect Bong-su, Gyeon-woo goes out every night for three years to find her. They eventually reunite, but Seong-ah has changed.

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Gyeon-u believes he met Seong-a, but it's Bong-su that he kissed; the new, delinquent Seong-a returns; the three people's real story begins now.
